title: A council's register of members' pecuniary interests as an HTML page of member tables citing the Act's clauses

landmarks: two or more <table>s whose first row is one cell with the member's role and name in bold
further rows: a number cell, then a cell whose bold text is the category citing '(section 54E(1)(a)' or '(s 54A(2)(a))'

signals_note: Invercargill City Council's register, 22 October 2026: 15 members, 71 category rows (13 real property, 12 spouse or partner withheld).
notes: The category is the bold text, the entries the plain paragraphs. Never read: a category naming real property, land, a home, an address, a contact, or a spouse's or partner's interests; an entry shaped like a street address, an email or a phone number is dropped. Both counted by heading only.
process: Each member table: role and name; each row its category and entries.
gates: No published category or entry of the withheld kinds (check.py).
on_fail: set the page aside; publish nothing that check.py holds red

title: A council's register (or one member's return) of pecuniary interests as a PDF (held, never read)

landmarks: linked from a council's register page by an address or words naming pecuniary interests or an interests register

signals_note: Recognised by where it is linked and its first bytes, never by its words.
notes: Held whole by sha256. Ruling 79: no document reading by a model until both boxes are up. Many print real property with its location and some members' homes (Waipā and Wairoa were flagged by the survey's search results): any later reader withholds those categories as the HTML reader does.
process: Land the bytes; record the hash against the council and the page that linked it.
on_fail: recorded as a page, not a document
